hypothesis: Adding exact technical anchors before Qwen increases the chance that the local search supplies the right conversation and message for technical questions.

conditions.A: Current desktop BM25 plus multilingual MiniLM routing; five chats and two messages per chat.
conditions.B: The same frozen library, BM25, MiniLM and five-chat limit, plus exact route/model/version/number anchors; up to five candidate messages are displayed per chat.

questions: Why did we add DeBERTa to the Pocket i harness, and why could it not be the only judge?
What relay rate limit was proposed to slow the spread of malicious messages between new recipients?
Why should passive room messages not always fail closed and ask the user for permission?
Why was the /x share feature not reachable even though its application code was already deployed?
evaluation: The owner inspects the private side-by-side HTML and marks whether the needed conversation and evidence are visible in A and B. No answer model or automatic semantic judge participates.
claim_boundary: This tests retrieval only. It does not test Qwen extraction, DeBERTa grounding, pile construction or final writing.
privacy: The protocol contains no private text. The generated HTML and JSON remain on the owner's computer and are never uploaded automatically.
